lens: A quiet day for new mandates — the calendar, not fresh signings, is the story: Huntsman/Olin's all-stock merger goes to its shareholder votes in 5 days (Citi, Morgan Stanley, Lazard), while yesterday's signings stay live — JBS's Pilgrim's Pride buy-in (Citi) and Francisco Partners' $7.40/share take-private of Weave (Jefferies). The tape turned risk-off again (VIX +4.6%), and the advisory boutiques gave back Tuesday's pop (Lazard -2.0%, Evercore -2.2%).

stories.headline: Huntsman/Olin all-stock merger votes are 5 days out (Aug 25); Citi and Morgan Stanley advise Huntsman, Lazard advises Olin
stories.why_it_matters: Olin (NYSE: OLN) and Huntsman (NYSE: HUN) hold special meetings on Aug 25, 2026 to vote on their all-stock merger (agreement dated Jun 15), after a supplemental proxy disclosure (Rule 425) filed Aug 17-18 to resolve shareholder litigation. The joint proxy names Citi and Morgan Stanley as Huntsman's financial advisers and Lazard as Olin's. With the vote days away, the chemicals combination is in its final antitrust, disclosure and dual shareholder-vote stretch — the most time-sensitive live process on the desk this week.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Citi/Morgan Stanley (Huntsman) and Lazard (Olin) now — with the vote 5 days out, a chemicals merger runs its final proxy-solicitation and closing diligence a secure room keeps organized.

deal_clock.event: Olin/Huntsman all-stock merger agreement signed
Supplemental proxy disclosure (Rule 425) filed
Huntsman and Olin special meetings (shareholder votes) — in 5 days

stories.headline: JBS's proposal to buy in the ~18% Pilgrim's Pride minority stays live; Citi advises JBS
stories.why_it_matters: JBS N.V. (NYSE: JBS), which owns ~82% of Pilgrim's Pride (NASDAQ: PPC), has a non-binding proposal (submitted Aug 18) to acquire the PPC shares it doesn't own at a fixed 2.086 JBS Class A shares per PPC share (implied ~$28.50/PPC share). Citi is JBS's financial adviser. The take-in is conditioned on a to-be-appointed special committee of independent PPC directors — which will retain its own advisers — and a majority-of-minority vote.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Citi (JBS) and watch for PPC's special committee to name its own independent adviser — a second, sell-side mandate on the same deal. A controlling-shareholder buy-in runs special-committee, fairness-opinion and proxy diligence a secure room organizes.

deal_clock.event: JBS submits non-binding proposal for PPC minority (2.086x exchange ratio)
PPC special committee to be appointed and retain independent advisers

stories.source: SEC EDGAR — JBS N.V. 8-K (EX-99.2, press release)

stories.headline: Francisco Partners' $7.40/share take-private of Weave Communications stays live; Jefferies advises Weave
stories.why_it_matters: Weave Communications (NYSE: WEAV), a SaaS customer-communications platform for healthcare and small-business practices, agreed Aug 18 to be taken private by Francisco Partners for $7.40/share in cash (~$650M equity value; $22.77M company break-fee). Weave's Board received the written fairness opinion of Jefferies LLC, its financial adviser. A sponsor take-private of a public software company runs fiduciary-out/go-shop, committed-financing and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Jefferies (Weave) — a $7.40/share software take-private runs fiduciary-out, financing and proxy diligence a secure room organizes through close.

deal_clock.event: Weave agrees to $7.40/share all-cash take-private by Francisco Partners

stories.headline: BioMarin's up-to-$490M acquisition of Alesta Therapeutics advances; Morgan Stanley advises BioMarin, JPMorgan advises Alesta
stories.why_it_matters: BioMarin (Nasdaq: BMRN) agreed Aug 18 to acquire Alesta Therapeutics for $275M upfront plus up to $215M in milestones ($490M total) for oral HPP candidate ALE1 (Alesta spins out its other assets). Morgan Stanley is exclusive financial adviser to BioMarin (buy-side) and J.P. Morgan to Alesta (sell-side). A milestone-structured biopharma acquisition runs IP, earn-out and integration workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Morgan Stanley (BioMarin) and JPMorgan (Alesta) — a milestone-structured biopharma acquisition runs IP, CVR/earn-out and integration diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: BioMarin agrees to acquire Alesta Therapeutics (up to $490M)

stories.headline: TTM Technologies' ~$1.1B acquisition of Epiq Solutions from Veritas advances; Guggenheim advises TTM
stories.why_it_matters: TTM Technologies (Nasdaq: TTMI) is acquiring Epiq Solutions — an ITAR-free defense software-defined-radio/RF platform — from Veritas Capital for ~$1.1B all-cash, expected to close Q4 2026. Guggenheim Securities is exclusive financial adviser to TTM; JPMorgan, BofA and Barclays provide committed financing. A defense-electronics acquisition runs ITAR/CFIUS, financing and integration workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Guggenheim (TTM) — a ~$1.1B defense-electronics acquisition runs ITAR/CFIUS, committed-financing and integration diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: TTM agrees to acquire Epiq Solutions from Veritas (~$1.1B)
Expected close (subject to regulatory approval)

stories.headline: Gentherm/Modine Reverse Morris Trust combination advances to a Sept 10 vote; Barclays advises Gentherm, BofA advises Modine
stories.why_it_matters: Gentherm (Nasdaq: THRM) will acquire Modine's Performance Technologies Business via a spin-off (Platinum SpinCo) and merger — a Reverse Morris Trust with ~$25M in synergies; the registration statement went effective Aug 12 and Gentherm's special meeting is Sept 10. Barclays advises Gentherm and BofA Securities advises Modine. A spin-and-merge runs separation, Section 355 tax-opinion, exchange-ratio and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Barclays (Gentherm) and BofA (Modine) — a Reverse Morris Trust spin-and-merge runs separation, tax-opinion and shareholder-vote diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Registration statement declared effective
Gentherm special meeting

stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Gentherm/Platinum SpinCo Form 425 (joint proxy/prospectus)

stories.headline: HomeTrust's ~$448M all-stock acquisition of Blue Ridge Bankshares advances; Piper Sandler advises HomeTrust
stories.why_it_matters: HomeTrust Bancshares (NYSE: HTB) is acquiring Blue Ridge Bankshares (NYSE American: BRBS) in an all-stock merger valued at ~$448.1M ($4.28/share), forming a $7B+ Southeast commercial bank; expected to close early Q1 2027. Piper Sandler is financial adviser to HomeTrust; Stephens advised Blue Ridge. A bank merger runs regulatory-approval and dual shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Piper Sandler (HomeTrust) — a ~$448M bank merger runs regulatory-approval and dual-company proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: HomeTrust agrees to acquire Blue Ridge Bankshares (~$448M)
Expected close

stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Blue Ridge / HomeTrust merger press release (EX-99.1)

stories.headline: Risk-off returns: stocks slip and the VIX pops ~4.6%, and the advisory boutiques give back Tuesday's rally (Lazard -2.0%, Evercore -2.2%)
stories.why_it_matters: Equities eased midday Aug 20 (S&P -0.31% to ~7,684, Nasdaq -0.79%, Dow -0.62%), the VIX rose ~4.6% to ~15.6 and the 10Y ticked up to ~4.68%. The pure-play advisers that ran on Tuesday reversed — Lazard -2.0% and Evercore -2.2% — while the universals were mixed (JPMorgan -0.2%, Goldman -0.6%, Morgan Stanley -0.9%). With no new large mandate signed today, the read is the calendar, not the tape: Huntsman/Olin's Aug 25 vote and a stack of live proxies are what move advisory pipeline this week.
stories.suggested_action: Keep the conversation on execution timelines, not the daily tape — a two-day boutique round-trip against a full vote/close calendar is a cue to talk room readiness for the deals already in motion.

The advisory boutiques that rallied Tuesday reversed — Lazard -2.0%, Evercore -2.2% — while the universals were mixed (JPMorgan -0.2%, Goldman -0.6%, Morgan Stanley -0.9%). Values are live Aug 20 intraday (~mid-session) levels.

talking_point.quote: Quiet day for new signings — which puts the spotlight on the calendar. Huntsman/Olin goes to its shareholder votes Monday, Aug 25 (Citi, Morgan Stanley, Lazard), and yesterday's mandates are live: Citi on JBS's Pilgrim's Pride buy-in and Jefferies on Weave's $7.40/share take-private. Meanwhile the boutique bid round-tripped in two sessions. When the tape is noisy and the pipeline is vote-driven, the conversation that matters is execution timelines — which of your live processes has the nearest vote or diligence milestone?
talking_point.use_with: Industrials/chemicals, consumer, TMT, healthcare and FIG coverage teams (esp. Citi, Morgan Stanley, Lazard, Jefferies, Guggenheim, Barclays, BofA, Piper Sandler)
talking_point.context: Anchors a quiet new-deal day on the live vote/close calendar rather than the daily tape — a reason-to-call built on milestones already on the board.

pipeline_watch.note: Named covered-bank mandates and sector heat. Rumored / no-adviser situations live in the Rumor Mill.

skeptics_corner.note: Unconfirmed leads — rumored deals and situations where no adviser is named yet. Real reporting, but treat as speculative: chase them, don't quote them on a call.

items.lead: Silver Lake is reportedly in talks to take Workday private at roughly $43B; the report sent Workday shares up ~20% before a trading halt.
items.why_unverified: Press-reported (Reuters exclusive, corroborated across Axios, CNBC, Barron's), not company-confirmed and no adviser named yet. A mega-cap software take-private that will mandate multiple advisers — an early, high-value tech reach-out signal.

items.lead: Karyopharm disclosed (8-K, Aug 13) that it, 'together with its financial advisor Centerview Partners and other advisors, is actively evaluating a range of financing opportunities and strategic alternatives,' with cash runway only into September 2026 and going-concern doubt.
items.why_unverified: Company-disclosed review confirmed in a primary 8-K with a covered adviser (Centerview) already engaged — but no transaction, buyer, price or timeline, and it is distress-driven. A named-adviser early signal, not a mandate: reach out early, don't quote a deal.

items.lead: Leslie's said it 'has begun exploring strategic alternatives with certain of our financial stakeholders,' which CEO Jason McDonell noted 'may include but are not limited to a deleveraging transaction, potentially combined with one or more financing transactions' (8-K, Aug 12).
items.why_unverified: Company-confirmed review in a primary filing, but no adviser named and it is leverage/balance-sheet-driven (the pool-supplies retailer carries a stockholders' deficit). A consumer/retail reach-out signal.

items.lead: Seritage said 'the strategic review process remains ongoing as the Company executes the Plan of Sale, and the Company remains open-minded to pursuing value-maximizing alternatives, including a potential sale of the Company' (8-K, Aug 14).
items.why_unverified: Company-confirmed in a primary filing, but no adviser named and it is a wind-down/Plan-of-Sale context. A real-estate reach-out signal.
items.source_note: SEC EDGAR — Seritage Growth Properties 8-K (EX-99.1), Aug 14 2026

items.lead: PayPal is reportedly in talks to sell itself to a consortium including Stripe and private-equity firm Advent, with reports the discussions are 'heating up.'
items.why_unverified: Press-reported (WSJ scoop, relayed across multiple outlets), not company-confirmed and no adviser named; a very large-cap situation that may already be widely known. Verify against the primary WSJ report before quoting.

items.why_unverified: Press-reported activist push, not company-confirmed; no adviser named. A post-merger asset-sale/carve-out signal for the energy desk — chase early.
